verdict.rationale: Cognee's own marketing states it is open source ('Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever') and docs describe local-only self-hosted runs (start_ui, Docker) implying source availability, but no evidence names an actual open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) or links to a public source repository, and no independent community confirmation of licensing terms is present. missing for 10: explicit license name/file, link to public source repo, independent verification of licensing terms.
